subject: Chemistry
title: Equilibrium
summary: Equilibrium dynamic hota hai: forward aur backward reaction dono chal rahi hoti hain, bas barabar speed se — isliye concentrations constant dikhte hain. Band system mein hi equilibrium banta hai.
Har reaction ka ek equilibrium constant hai (Kc, Kp) jo sirf temperature par depend karta hai. K bada ⇒ products zyada; Q ko K se compare karke pata chalta hai reaction kis taraf chalegi.

Le Chatelier: equilibrium ko chhedo (concentration, pressure, temperature badlo) to system us badlaav ko kam karne ki taraf khisakta hai. Catalyst sirf jaldi pahunchaata hai, equilibrium nahi badalta.
Ionic equilibrium: strong electrolytes poore ionise, weak thode. Weak acid/base ki ionisation Ka/Kb se, paani ki Kw se. pH = −log[H⁺].
Teen bade application: buffer (pH ko stable rakhna — Henderson equation), salt hydrolysis (salt ka pH), aur solubility product Ksp (kam ghulne wale salt kitna ghulenge, kab precipitate banega).

formulas.name: Law of chemical equilibrium
formulas.when: Kisi bhi reversible reaction ka K likhna.
formulas.mistake: Pure solids aur pure liquids (aur dilute solution mein solvent) K mein nahi aate.

formulas.name: Kp and Kc
formulas.formula: Kp = Kc (RT)^{Δn_g}   (R = 0.0821 L·atm/(K·mol), p atm mein)
formulas.note: Δn_g = gaseous products ke moles − reactants ke moles; Δn_g = 0 ⇒ Kp = Kc.

formulas.name: Manipulating K
formulas.formula: Ulti reaction: K' = 1/K.   Reaction × n: K' = Kⁿ.   Do reactions jodo: K = K₁ × K₂
formulas.when: Di hui reactions se nayi ka K.

formulas.name: Reaction quotient
formulas.formula: Q (same expression, kisi bhi pal ke concentrations):  Q < K → forward,  Q > K → backward,  Q = K → equilibrium

formulas.name: Degree of dissociation (example PCl₅)
formulas.formula: PCl₅ ⇌ PCl₃ + Cl₂:   Kp = α² P / (1 − α²)
formulas.when: Dissociation wale gas sawal; α = ditna hissa toota.
formulas.note: Total moles = 1 + α (1 mol PCl₅ se shuru).

formulas.name: ΔG and K
formulas.formula: ΔG° = −RT ln K;   ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q;   equilibrium par ΔG = 0

formulas.name: Temperature dependence (van 't Hoff)
formulas.note: Endothermic: T badhe → K badhe. Exothermic: T badhe → K ghate.

formulas.name: Le Chatelier — quick table
formulas.formula: Reactant badhao → forward.  Pressure badhao → kam gas moles wali side.  T badhao → endothermic side.  Catalyst → koi shift nahi.  Inert gas (V const) → koi shift nahi;  (p const) → zyada moles wali side
formulas.mistake: Sirf temperature K ko badalta hai; baaki sab sirf position badalte hain.

formulas.name: Henry's law
formulas.formula: p = K_H x   (gas ka partial pressure ∝ solution mein uska mole fraction)
formulas.when: Gas ka liquid mein ghulna (soda, scuba diving).
formulas.note: Temperature badhe to gas ki solubility ghatti hai.

formulas.name: Ionic product of water
formulas.note: Kw temperature ke saath badhta hai — garam paani ka neutral pH 7 se kam hota hai (phir bhi neutral).

formulas.name: Weak acid (Ostwald dilution law)
formulas.formula: α = √(Ka/C);   [H⁺] = √(Ka C);   pH = ½(pKa − log C)
formulas.when: Weak acid ka pH aur α.
formulas.mistake: Tabhi valid jab α < 5% ho (1 − α ≈ 1).

formulas.name: Weak base
formulas.when: NH₃ jaise weak base ka pH.

formulas.name: Conjugate pair
formulas.when: Acid ke conjugate base ka Kb (ya ulta).
formulas.note: Strong acid ka conjugate base bahut weak hota hai.

formulas.name: Polyprotic acids
formulas.formula: H₂A: Ka₁ ≫ Ka₂;   pH lagbhag sirf Ka₁ se;  [A²⁻] ≈ Ka₂
formulas.note: Doosra proton nikalna mushkil (negative ion se).

formulas.name: Common ion effect
formulas.formula: Weak acid HA + uska salt (A⁻, conc C'):  α ≈ Ka / C'
formulas.when: Common ion ionisation ko dabata hai.
formulas.note: Common ion se weak electrolyte ka α ghatta hai.

formulas.name: Salt hydrolysis
formulas.formula: SA + SB: pH = 7.   WA + SB (CH₃COONa): pH = 7 + ½pKa + ½log C.   SA + WB (NH₄Cl): pH = 7 − ½pKb − ½log C.   WA + WB: pH = 7 + ½(pKa − pKb)  (C se independent)

formulas.name: Buffer (Henderson–Hasselbalch)
formulas.formula: Acidic: pH = pKa + log([salt]/[acid]).   Basic: pOH = pKb + log([salt]/[base])

formulas.name: Solubility product
formulas.formula: AₓB_y: Ksp = (xs)^x (ys)^y.   AB: s²,  AB₂/A₂B: 4s³,  AB₃/A₃B: 27s⁴,  A₂B₃: 108s⁵
formulas.when: Solubility s (mol/L) aur Ksp ka relation.
formulas.mistake: Alag type ke salts ki solubility sirf Ksp dekh kar compare mat karo — s nikaal ke karo.

formulas.name: Precipitation and common ion
formulas.formula: Ionic product Q_sp > Ksp ⇒ precipitate.   AB in C M common ion: s ≈ Ksp / C
formulas.when: Precipitate banega ya nahi; common ion mein solubility.
formulas.note: Mixing ke baad naye (dilute) concentrations lo.

examples.title: Equilibrium concentration
examples.problem: A + B ⇌ C + D, Kc = 4. Shuru mein [A] = [B] = 1 M. Equilibrium par [C]?

examples.title: Weak acid ka pH
examples.problem: 0.1 M CH₃COOH, Ka = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵. [H⁺], pH aur % ionisation?

examples.title: Buffer ka pH
examples.problem: 0.1 M CH₃COOH + 0.2 M CH₃COONa, pKa = 4.74. pH?

examples.title: Ksp aur common ion
examples.problem: AgCl ka Ksp = 1.8 × 10⁻¹⁰. Paani mein solubility? 0.1 M NaCl mein?
examples.solution: Paani: s = √Ksp = 1.34 × 10⁻⁵ M. 0.1 M Cl⁻ mein: s = Ksp/0.1 = 1.8 × 10⁻⁹ M — ~7500 guna kam (common ion effect).

examples.title: Bahut dilute strong acid
examples.solution: Paani ka H⁺ bhi gino: [H⁺] = x, [OH⁻] = x − 10⁻⁸, x(x − 10⁻⁸) = 10⁻¹⁴ ⇒ x ≈ 1.05 × 10⁻⁷ M ⇒ pH ≈ 6.98 — thoda acidic, 7 se kam.

topics.title: Dynamic equilibrium
topics.explain: Band bottle mein paani: evaporation aur condensation dono chalte rehte hain, rate barabar ⇒ vapour pressure constant. Chemical equilibrium bhi aisa hi — dono taraf se pahuncha ja sakta hai.

topics.title: Physical equilibria
topics.explain: Solid ⇌ liquid (barf-paani, 0°C, 1 atm par), liquid ⇌ vapour (band bartan mein vapour pressure), solid ⇌ vapour (camphor, iodine — sublimation), gas ⇌ solution (soda mein CO₂ — Henry's law). Har ek ki pehchaan: koi ek property constant ho jaati hai, aur ye fixed T par hi hota hai.

topics.title: K ka matlab
topics.explain: K > 10³: lagbhag poori forward. K < 10⁻³: bahut kam forward. Beech mein: dono kaafi. K sirf temperature se badalta hai, concentration ya catalyst se nahi. K ki units Δn par depend karti hain.

topics.title: Le Chatelier ke classic examples
topics.explain: Haber process (N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃, exothermic): high pressure aur NH₃ hataate rehna forward le jaate hain; low T se yield zyada lekin speed kam — isliye ~700 K aur Fe catalyst. N₂O₄ ⇌ 2NO₂ (endothermic): garam karo to bhoora rang badhta hai.

topics.title: Strong vs weak electrolytes
topics.explain: Strong (NaCl, HCl, NaOH): paani mein lagbhag 100% ions. Weak (CH₃COOH, NH₃): thoda sa ionise, baaki molecule. Dilution par weak electrolyte ka α badhta hai (Ostwald).

topics.title: Acid–base ke teen concepts
topics.explain: Arrhenius: paani mein H⁺ de = acid, OH⁻ de = base (sirf aqueous). Brønsted–Lowry: proton donor = acid, acceptor = base; conjugate pairs (HCl/Cl⁻, NH₄⁺/NH₃). Lewis: electron pair acceptor = acid (BF₃, AlCl₃, H⁺, metal ions), donor = base (NH₃, H₂O, OH⁻).

topics.title: Acid strength ka trend
topics.explain: Ka bada (pKa chhota) = strong acid. Same group mein neeche jaate bond kamzor ⇒ HF < HCl < HBr < HI. Same period mein electronegativity badhe ⇒ CH₄ < NH₃ < H₂O < HF acidity.

topics.title: pH scale
topics.explain: pH 7 neutral (25°C), < 7 acidic, > 7 basic. pH 1 ka farak = [H⁺] mein 10 guna. Do strong acids mix: moles jodo, total volume se divide.

topics.title: Buffer kaise kaam karta hai
topics.explain: Acidic buffer (CH₃COOH + CH₃COONa): daala gaya H⁺ CH₃COO⁻ se jud jaata hai, OH⁻ CH₃COOH se neutralise. Basic buffer: NH₃ + NH₄Cl. Blood ka buffer H₂CO₃/HCO₃⁻ (pH ≈ 7.4).

topics.title: Salt hydrolysis ka logic
topics.explain: Weak acid ka anion (CH₃COO⁻) paani se H⁺ leke OH⁻ chhodta hai ⇒ basic. Weak base ka cation (NH₄⁺) H⁺ deta hai ⇒ acidic. Strong ke ions hydrolyse nahi hote (NaCl neutral).

topics.title: Ksp ke uses
topics.explain: Precipitate banega jab Q_sp > Ksp. Selective precipitation: jiska Ksp chhota pehle girega. Common ion solubility ghataata hai; jo ions complex bana lein (AgCl + NH₃) wo solubility badha dete hain.

ratta: Kp = Kc(RT)^{Δn_g};  ulti reaction 1/K;  ×n → Kⁿ;  jodo → multiply.
Q < K forward, Q > K backward.
Sirf T se K badalta hai; catalyst K nahi badalta.
Hydrolysis: WA+SB pH = 7 + ½pKa + ½logC;  SA+WB pH = 7 − ½pKb − ½logC;  WA+WB pH = 7 + ½(pKa − pKb).
Ksp: AB s²,  AB₂ 4s³,  AB₃ 27s⁴,  A₂B₃ 108s⁵.
10⁻⁸ M HCl ka pH ≈ 6.98 (paani ka H⁺ jodo).
Lewis acid = e⁻ pair acceptor (BF₃, AlCl₃);  Lewis base = donor (NH₃).
